text: 下面进入口袋 02 · 大作文口袋 10 句与三大极性框架卡，英式思维与留白盲拼训练。
【正向极性 · 成因总起】不要写 There are many reasons。请用 account for 与 Chief among 倒装：
A multitude of economic and social factors easily account for this trend, and chief among them is that rapid growth has made it remarkably convenient to access quality resources.
手术刀：account for 解释成因，Chief among 倒装接 made it 形式宾语。
【负向极性 · 含蓄否定】批判坏习惯，不要写 not enough。请用 far from 与 whereas 对比：
Relying solely on rules is far from enough; those adhering to discipline reap rewards, whereas those indulging in ease fail to achieve growth.
手术刀：far from 与 fail to 实现零 not 学术批判，whereas 撑起对比论证。
【尾段压轴 · Only 倒装】提取“只有共同努力我们才能克服障碍”的正确倒装语序：
Not only can this spirit enrich individual life, but it also propels social progress; only through joint efforts can we conquer obstacles.
手术刀：Only + 介词短语置句首时，can 提到 we 前，严禁逗号接 we can。
